payload.explanation: The diagnostic report shows the business request (session_2b762b90c6f8) waiting on a transactionid lock held by session_a47e5db4aecb, which is idle in transaction after running the same UPDATE on inventory. The state report confirms session_a47e5db4aecb is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request itself must not be modified directly.
